mentions.name: Personal AI Trading System Builder
mentions.description: A platform for building personal AI trading systems that uses TradingView-style alerts as triggers for n8n workflows to run analysis and order executions with live market data monitoring. Analysis is triggered at meaningful moments generated by the user's own technical indicators instead of fixed schedules, and runs through personally configured, inspectable steps with detailed info so workflows can be reviewed, tuned, and made reproducible and reliable.
mentions.problem: Most existing "AI trading" tools run analysis on fixed schedules (e.g., every 5 minutes or daily) and perform analysis through an AI black box with no transparency into how the analysis is performed or what data was referenced.
mentions.audience: Personal use; the author builds it for their own trading and wonders whether other traders value transparency similarly.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been working on this project for building personal AI trading systems.

The core idea is using TradingView style alert system as N8N workflow trigger to run analysis and order executions with live market data monitoring.
